text.tspan: Weekly confirmed COVID-19 deaths, 12 BCE to 2308
Cumulative number of confirmed deaths over the previous week. Due to varying protocols and challenges in the
attribution of the cause of death, the number of confirmed deaths may not accurately represent the true
number of deaths caused by COVID-19.
